tools.name: book_flight
tools.description: Book the flight. Returns Ticket { ticket_id, quote_id, mandate_id, passenger_ans, flight, issued_at, scitt_receipt }. Signed with dpop (dpop). Prerequisites: quote_id, mandate, dpop_proof.

dpop_proof.description: DPoP JWS proving possession of the mandate's jkt key.

mandate.description: The signed mandate JSON from request_mandate. (from prerequisite: mandate)

option_id.description: Falls back to quote_id when empty.

quote_id.description: Same quote_id bound in the mandate.
